statement: The function returns a result r, and r is the maximum of the set {0} union { e - l + 1 | there exist integers l and e such that 0 <= l <= e < len(nums), nums[l] % 2 == 0, for every i with l <= i < e we have nums[i] % 2 != nums[i+1] % 2, and for every i with l <= i <= e we have nums[i] <= threshold }.
